Animal Services & Enforcement

Our department encourages the adoption of shelter animals by responsible families. Each year the City of Corona Animal Shelter cares for thousands of stray, lost, or homeless animals in need of new homes. You are invited to visit our animal shelter to select a pet from our companion animals available for adoption.

Our goal is to find the best homes possible and to enhance the lives of our community, by bringing people and animals closer together. We do not sell pets, we adopt companion animals to loving homes for a lifetime commitment.
